screen.levelupstats.title: Character Stats

message.levelupstats.marker_set: Marker placed. You are pulled back beyond %s blocks.

perk.levelupstats.ore_glow.desc: Right-click a stone or deepslate wall with a pickaxe to make nearby ores glow in their colours.
perk.levelupstats.lightning.desc: Sneak and hit with an axe to call lightning (it can hit pets!). 20 s cooldown.
perk.levelupstats.vein_mine.desc: Sneak and mine an ore to break the whole vein (up to 64 blocks).
perk.levelupstats.tree_chop.desc: Sneak and chop a log with an axe to fell the whole tree (up to 64 blocks).
perk.levelupstats.mark_tp.desc: Place a marker. Go over 50 blocks away and you're pulled back. Teleport back manually any time, even across dimensions.
perk.levelupstats.heartbeat.desc: Sneak for 15 s: the world goes dark but mobs glow, red for hostile and green for passive. Fainter from 30 to 90 blocks.
perk.levelupstats.stasis.desc: Freeze mobs within 10 blocks for 5 s (bosses 3 s). 2 min cooldown.
perk.levelupstats.decoy.desc: Leave a decoy that mobs attack for 8 s while you turn invisible.
perk.levelupstats.earthshaker.desc: Falling 4+ blocks makes a shockwave and no fall damage. Knockback scales with Strength.
perk.levelupstats.second_wind.desc: Survive a lethal hit at 30% health. 2 day cooldown.
perk.levelupstats.mob_peace.desc: Hostile mobs won't attack you unless you provoke them.
perk.levelupstats.egg.desc: Conjure any non-boss spawn egg every 2 days. Needs the 'Free the End' advancement.
perk.levelupstats.pocket.desc: Right-click a mob under 80% of your max health to store it. Place it to release it, with its stats and gear intact. Bosses and players excluded.
